title: Fleet Agent Operations
description: Multi-agent fleet telemetry dashboard. KPIs, tool usage, model efficiency, and session health for managing fleets of AI agents.

widgets.title: Active Sessions (5m)
widgets.raw: SELECT count(distinct attributes.session.id) FROM Span WHERE attributes.session.id IS NOT NULL AND event.timestamp > ago(5m)

widgets.title: Total Tool Calls
widgets.raw: SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE name LIKE 'tool.%'

widgets.title: Sessions per Model
widgets.raw: SELECT count(distinct attributes.session.id) FROM Span WHERE attributes.gen_ai.request.model IS NOT NULL FACET attributes.gen_ai.request.model

widgets.title: Total Cost (USD)
widgets.raw: SELECT sum(cost) FROM Metric WHERE metric.name = 'cost.usage'

widgets.title: Session Success Rate
widgets.raw: SELECT (filter(count(*), WHERE name = 'session.idle') / filter(count(*), WHERE name = 'session.created')) * 100 FROM Span

widgets.title: Sessions Timeline
widgets.raw: SELECT count(distinct attributes.session.id) FROM Span WHERE name = 'agent.session.primary' TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Tool Usage Heatmap
widgets.raw: SELECT count(*) as calls, count(filter(*, WHERE attributes.tool.error = 1)) as errors, round(count(*)/count(*), 2) as error_rate, attributes.tool.name FROM Span WHERE name = 'tool.execute.after' FACET attributes.tool.name ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 50

widgets.title: Agent-Model Matrix
widgets.raw: SELECT count(distinct attributes.session.id) as sessions, count(distinct attributes.gen_ai.system) as agent_roles FROM Span WHERE attributes.session.id IS NOT NULL FACET attributes.gen_ai.system, attributes.gen_ai.request.model

widgets.title: Complexity vs Outcome
widgets.raw: SELECT attributes.session.id, sum(attributes.gen_ai.token_usage.input) as input_tokens, sum(attributes.gen_ai.token_usage.output) as output_tokens, count(*) as spans FROM Span WHERE attributes.session.id IS NOT NULL FACET attributes.session.id LIMIT 200

widgets.title: Tool Execution Latency
widgets.raw: SELECT histogram(duration, 100, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000) FROM Span WHERE name LIKE 'tool.%' FACET name

widgets.title: Model Efficiency
widgets.raw: SELECT count(*) as invocations, sum(attributes.gen_ai.token_usage.input) as input_tokens, sum(cost) as cost FROM Metric WHERE metric.name = 'gen_ai.client.invocation.count' FACET attributes.gen_ai.request.model

widgets.title: Session Latency
widgets.raw: SELECT attributes.session.id, sum(attributes.gen_ai.token_usage.total) as tokens, sum(cost) as cost FROM Metric WHERE metric.name = 'gen_ai.client.token.usage' OR metric.name = 'session.cost.total' FACET attributes.session.id LIMIT 100

widgets.title: Error / Failure Tracking
widgets.raw: SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE attributes.tool.error = 1 OR name = 'session.error' TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Tool Decision Log
widgets.raw: SELECT event.timestamp, attributes.session.id, attributes.tool.name, attributes.tool.error FROM Log WHERE event.name = 'tool_result' ORDER BY event.timestamp DESC LIMIT 50
